fields.options:
Add this to your Print Format's HTML, sized to match the Width/Height on the right (in points; roughly px at 96dpi):

<div style="display:inline-block; position:relative; width:150px; height:50px;">
  <span style="color:#ffffff; position:absolute; left:0; bottom:0;">##DIGITAL_SIGN_ANCHOR##</span>
</div>

The stamp's bottom-left corner is placed exactly where the anchor text itself sits - not just anywhere inside the reserved box - so position:absolute; left:0; bottom:0; pins it to that box's own bottom-left corner. Without that positioning, the anchor sits at the box's top by default and the stamp (which extends upward-right from the anchor) ends up overlapping content above the box instead of filling it.

Use color:#ffffff (matching the background), not opacity:0 - some PDF engines skip painting opacity:0 text entirely, dropping it from the searchable text layer too. If the surrounding background isn't white, match this color to it instead.
